news.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6：多模态推理与 10 万亿参数
news.content: OpenAI 于 2026 年 7 月 21 日正式发布 GPT-6。新模型参数量达到 10 万亿，较 GPT-5 提升约 5 倍。GPT-6 引入原生多模态推理能力，可同时处理文本、图像、音频和视频输入，并在推理任务上实现显著提升。OpenAI CEO 表示，GPT-6 在 MMLU、GSM8K 等基准测试中均创下单项新高。模型将于下周通过 API 向开发者开放。

news.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 with 10 trillion parameters
news.content: OpenAI launched GPT-6 on July 21, 2026, with 10 trillion parameters, a 5x increase over GPT-5. The new model features native multimodal reasoning and achieves state-of-the-art results on MMLU and GSM8K benchmarks. CEO announced the API will be available to developers next week. The model is expected to reshape the competitive landscape of foundation models.

news.title: GPT-6 来了：参数翻 5 倍，OpenAI 再次拉开差距
news.content: 36氪 7 月 21 日消息，OpenAI 今日发布 GPT-6，参数量达 10 万亿，较 GPT-5 翻 5 倍。新模型在多模态推理、长文本理解上有显著提升。业内分析认为，GPT-6 的发布将进一步拉大 OpenAI 与竞争对手的差距。多家国内大模型厂商表示将加速追赶。

news.title: 美联储 7 月议息会议：维持利率不变
news.content: 美联储 7 月议息会议结束，决定维持联邦基金利率目标区间在 5.25%-5.50% 不变。声明指出通胀仍高于目标，但点阵图显示年内可能降息一次。主席在新闻发布会上表示，将依据数据决定后续政策路径。市场预期 9 月降息概率升至 70%。

news.title: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Signals Possible Cut This Year
news.content: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark rate at 5.25%-5.50% at the July meeting. The dot plot indicates one possible cut this year. The Chair said future policy will depend on data. Markets priced in a 70% probability of a September cut. Global equities rose following the announcement.

news.title: GPT-6 benchmark results: OpenAI claims new SOTA across reasoning tasks
news.content: TechCrunch reports: OpenAI's GPT-6 sets new state-of-the-art on MMLU (92.1%), GSM8K (97.3%), and HumanEval (95.8%). The model shows significant improvement in multi-step reasoning and code generation. Independent researchers are verifying the claims. Compared to GPT-5, GPT-6 reduces hallucination rates by 40% according to OpenAI's internal evals.

news.title: 美联储按兵不动：对 A 股与人民币的影响几何
news.content: 财新网 7 月 21 日报道，美联储维持利率不变，市场对 9 月降息预期升温。分析师认为，若美联储年内降息，将缓解人民币贬值压力，A 股外资流入或增加。但短期仍需关注国内经济数据。机构建议关注受益于流动性宽松的成长板块。

news.title: GPT-6's multimodal reasoning could change how we interact with AI
news.content: The Verge analysis: GPT-6's native multimodal reasoning allows it to process text, images, audio, and video simultaneously. This enables new use cases like real-time video analysis and cross-modal question answering. OpenAI demonstrated GPT-6 analyzing a cooking video and answering questions about ingredients in real-time. The feature will roll out to ChatGPT Plus users first.
